fact: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology stated in October 2026 that Egypt carried out more than 760 cyber defence operations nationwide during 2025, and that the Supreme Cybersecurity Council is guided by the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2023-2027 while the National Computer and Network Emergency Readiness Centre leads incident response.
title: «وزارة الاتصالات»: مصر تنفذ أكثر من 760 عملية للدفاع السيبراني خلال 2025
